title: policy_lint.mjs comments point at pre-move paths: usage lines, corpus_excluded.json, preflight.sh, decisions, delivery
claim: 12 comment units of tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs name a path absent at 92d38ecb in a present-tense sentence, among them the header's six usage lines `node .claude/workflows/policy_lint.mjs ...` (node exits MODULE_NOT_FOUND) and the line 589 statement that the round-evidence exclusions 'live in .claude/workflows/corpus_excluded.json' while CORPUS_EXCLUDED_DATA reads dev/governance/config/corpus_excluded.json.
